title: Russian Vegetable Fritters
description: A crispy and delicious appetizer or snack made with a mix of vegetables and a hint of Russian flavor.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine mixed vegetables, quick bread mix, crispy onion, Russian dill, egg, milk, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the mixture into the hot oil, about 1/4 cup each.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce, such as sour cream or Russian dressing.
